text: Great Bookshelf. Great bookshelf that I'm using as a dog station....very durable, not wobbly at all

product_metadata.title: TomCare Bookshelf 3-Tier Wood and Metal Shelves Industrial Bookcase Display Office Storage Rack Multifunctional Furniture for Entryway Living Room Bedroom Home Office Kitchen
features: Vintage Style: The classic retro look brings a different sense of fashion to your home. No matter where you place it, it will give you a unique feeling.
Variety of Functions: This 3-tier shelf can be used not only for books, but also for other items and decorations. If you need a perfect display rack, it will also be a good choice for you.
Protect Your Floor: With 4 adjustable feet, it can effectively prevent your floor from being scratched. When your table is unstable, you can enhance the stability of your shelf by adjusting them.

High Quality: MDF materials with wood grain and quality steel can make your shelves extend the life of your shelf. The size of each board is 23.62” x 11.41”, which can provide you enough space to place your supplies.
Waterproof and Rustproof: This bookshelf has a smooth surface, which is waterproof. And the metal structure with black finish is sturdy and rustproof, perfectly extended service life.
